title: Project SFB
description: Project SFB introduces experimental rocket payloads that turn ordinary fireworks into powerful tactical weapons.
body:
Strategic Fusion Ballistics

Project SFB is an experimental Minecraft plugin that transforms ordinary fireworks into advanced tactical rocket payloads.

Built under the Strategic Fusion Ballistics initiative, this project introduces custom rockets designed with unique behaviors, impact mechanics, and area effects. Instead of simple visual fireworks, these rockets interact with the world in far more dynamic ways.

Project SFB focuses on expanding projectile gameplay with new mechanics while keeping the system compatible with vanilla Minecraft equipment such as the crossbow.
